faq.a: Azeem is associated with the Arabic form عظيم, whose core sense is great, magnificent, glorious.

faq.q: What is the origin of Azeem?
faq.a: Azeem is associated with Arabic. ʿAẓīm ('great, magnificent'); al-ʿAẓīm is one of the divine names.
Yes — the underlying form عظيم is Arabic.
Azeem can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Azeem should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. العظيم is a name of God in the Qur'an
